fit: Full-data explanatory hierarchical EBL, fixed three-kilometer representation; includes target outcomes. Not geographic held-out evaluation.
effect_intervals: Conditional grid-based effect quantiles at estimated coefficients and variance. Odds intervals exponentiate effect endpoints.
ranks: 5000 conditional vectors; ranks computed across all 1383 airports within each draw; rank one is largest effect. Split halves contain 2500 draws each.
numerical_checks: The estimation script asserted small boundary mass for every grid. The fit metadata records adaptive-integration comparisons for four means. Split-half rank endpoints are Monte Carlo diagnostics, not independent replication.
external_ratio_join: All 1383 explanatory rows remain. External O/E and E are available for the 1375 national geographic profiles. Eight target entries are empty because targets use temporal predictions.
uncertainty: Fixed coefficient and variance estimates; no simultaneous coverage claim or validated safety ordering.
legacy_display_note: display_definition.json preserves the source table verbatim. Its broad attribution of all intervals to 5000 vectors is clarified here: effect intervals use grid quantiles, rank intervals use the draws.
